components.name: Tool card
components.description: Hub catalog cell with per-card CSS variables for accent and glow.
components.html: decisionwheel.neorgon.comDecision WheelSpin up priorities with a customizable wheel.Tools
components.css: .ds-site-card { position:relative; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:12px; max-width:340px; padding:28px; border-radius:16px; text-decoration:none; color:#f0f4ff; background:rgba(0,12,24,.82); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08); box-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(0,0,0,.6); transition:border-color .2s, box-shadow .3s; overflow:hidden; } .ds-site-card:hover { border-color:var(--card-glow-border,rgba(255,255,255,.2)); box-shadow:0 0 24px rgba(0,0,0,.65), 0 0 0 1px var(--card-glow-border,rgba(255,255,255,.15)); } .ds-site-card:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #818cf8; outline-offset:4px; } .ds-card-domain { font-size:.72rem; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.06em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--card-accent,#818cf8); } .ds-card-name { font-size:1.05rem; font-weight:700; line-height:1.3; } .ds-card-desc { font-size:.875rem; color:#8fa0c0; line-height:1.6; } .ds-card-tags { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:6px; } .ds-card-tag { font-size:.68rem; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.04em; text-transform:uppercase; padding:3px 8px; border-radius:10px; color:var(--card-accent,#818cf8); border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--card-accent,#818cf8) 30%, transparent); background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--card-accent,#818cf8) 8%, transparent); }

components.name: Hero search
components.description: Frosted catalog search with plasma focus ring.
components.css: .ds-search-wrap { max-width:480px; } .ds-hero-search { width:100%; box-sizing:border-box; padding:14px 44px; border-radius:14px; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1); background:rgba(255,255,255,.04); color:#f0f4ff; font-size:.95rem; outline:none; transition:border-color .25s, box-shadow .25s, background .25s; } .ds-hero-search::placeholder { color:rgba(255,255,255,.4); } .ds-hero-search:hover { border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.14); } .ds-hero-search:focus { border-color:rgba(192,132,252,.45); box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(192,132,252,.1), 0 0 24px rgba(192,132,252,.08); background:rgba(255,255,255,.06); }

components.name: Hero badge
components.description: Uppercase status chip with pulsing dot.
components.html: Built different · Shipped anyway
components.css: .ds-hero-badge { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; padding:5px 14px; border-radius:20px; background:rgba(120,0,255,.12); border:1px solid rgba(160,80,255,.25); color:#c084fc; font-size:.75rem; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.08em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-hero-badge-dot { width:6px; height:6px; border-radius:50%; background:#c084fc; }

components.name: Skip link
components.css: .ds-skip-link { position:relative; display:inline-block; padding:8px 16px; background:#818cf8; color:#000000; font-weight:600; font-size:.875rem; border-radius:0 0 8px 8px; text-decoration:none; } .ds-skip-link:focus { outline:2px solid #f0f4ff; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Header icon control
components.description: Circular ghost icon button used in site header.
components.css: .ds-header-icon { width:40px; height:40px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; border-radius:50%; border:1px solid transparent; color:rgba(255,255,255,.85); text-decoration:none; font-size:.7rem; font-weight:700; transition:color .2s, border-color .2s, background .2s; } .ds-header-icon:hover { color:#ffffff; border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.15); background:rgba(255,255,255,.18); } .ds-header-icon:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #818cf8; outline-offset:2px; }

narrative.overview: Neorgon reads as mission control in deep space: a void field, faint grid, slow starfield, and a constellation of tool cards where each destination gets its own accent hue (set inline via CSS variables). The UI is dark-first for contrast against neon waypoints and long scan sessions. Density is catalog-forward: section rails, uppercase micro-labels, and a responsive auto-fill grid keep tools scannable. Motion supports discovery but defers to prefers-reduced-motion for ambient layers.
keyCharacteristics: Per-tool accent injection through CSS variables on each card; default fallback indigo #818cf8.
Tonal depth from true void #000912 through semi-opaque card shells and soft borders.
Glass touches reserved for the hero search and small floating controls.
Focus and skip use the same indigo language as default accents.
Typography is a single humanist-geometric sans stack with a steep weight ladder on the hero.

rules.name: The Per-Card Beacon Rule
rules.body: Each tool card sets its own --card-accent, --card-glow, and --card-glow-border in inline style. Do not collapse the hub to a single brand accent for cards.

rules.name: The Void-First Rule
rules.body: Background stays at or near #000912. Do not introduce pure #000000 or pure #ffffff fields.

rules.name: The One-Stack Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce a second display serif or a monospace marketing font on the hub.

rules.name: The Glow-Is-State Rule
rules.body: Neon glows intensify on interaction. Static chrome should not read brighter than interactive elements.

dos: Do keep the tool grid as the honest center of gravity; hero and atmosphere exist to route into #tools.
Do assign each new tool card explicit --card-accent, --card-glow, and --card-glow-border values consistent with the hub registry.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion for starfield and decorative canvases.
Do pair icon-only header controls with aria-label and keep :focus-visible indigo ring visible.
donts: Don't bury the catalog behind generic SaaS landing patterns that PRODUCT.md forbids: hero metrics blocks, endless identical icon-plus-blurb grids with no real links, or modal newsletter traps on first paint.
Don't ship the interchangeable AI-wrapper look from PRODUCT.md: purple gradients on white, stock robot illustrations, or vague 10x productivity slabs.
Don't use dark patterns from PRODUCT.md: fake urgency, signup walls for read-only discovery, or ads disguised as tools.
Don't flatten the hub into corporate trust-center blandness.
Don't use border-left or border-right thicker than 1px as a decorative accent stripe on cards or list rows.
Don't add new gradient-text marketing spans outside the existing hero word treatment.
